decision.observed_event: You want in. Two ways to play a round: settle it with one check, or play it out as twenty-one (blackjack), closest to 21 without going over. The stake is whatever you bet; the house plays 10 gp a round. Which way?

improv_read.player_bid: Wren grabs the dealer's wrist and accuses him of dealing from the bottom; the table records the game offer.
improv_read.connection: Uktarl cheats, but the deal has not begun; he uses the early accusation to look honest and draw her in.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit plays the offer the table made and lets the dealer use the premature accusation to his advantage.

public_brief.objective: Shrug off an accusation before anything has happened and keep her at the table.
public_brief.tactic: Point out calmly that nothing has been dealt and turn her suspicion into a dare to bet.
public_brief.visible_cue: He looks at the hand on his wrist; the deck is still squared in his other hand.
public_brief.player_opening: She can let go and choose how to play, or keep pressing.
public_brief.reply_to: That one came from the bottom. Turn the deck over.
public_brief.kit_focus: Make it plain through the squared, undealt deck that the round has not started yet.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, no humor: cool and clear

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The dealer looks down at your fingers around his wrist, then up at you, unbothered. The deck sits squared in his other hand, not a single card yet dealt.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: From the bottom? My dear, I have not dealt you so much as a whisper. You accuse the cards before they are even out of the box. I admire a suspicious mind, it makes for brave betting. Release me, and choose how you will lose to me: hand by hand, or all at once?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: choose how you will lose to me
